name: Lotebush
caution: Edible in small amounts when ripe; a spiny, tangled shrub to reach into carefully. Never eat a wild plant on this guide's word alone. Confirm identity against several sources and learn the look-alikes first.

sections.title: Identification
sections.body: A gray, zig-zagging thorny shrub of dry ground, a wild relative of the jujube, with thin sweet fruit around a large stone.

sections.title: On the trail
sections.body: More survival food than delicacy, but a real one where little else grows.
